original_prompt: Dry sand pours from a cup onto a flat table, emptying the cup as a conical pile grows below.

initial_condition.description: A visible hand holds the sand cup so it can tilt and control the grain flow.

pre_event_image_prompt: A realistic fixed side-view photograph of one visible hand holding one upright clear cup filled with pale dry sand above a bare wooden table. The cup is centered over an empty landing area, still upright before pouring, and every grain remains inside with no stream or pile yet. Show the cup, hand, vertical drop path, and a broad tabletop area clearly and at useful scale. One continuous 1280x704 landscape frame.
text_policy: pre_event_image_prompt is used verbatim for image generation
